Amla hair oil
Amla oil, also known as Indian gooseberry oil, has many potential benefits, including:
Hair health: Amla oil is a popular hair care product that can help with hair growth, prevent hair loss, and treat dandruff and lice. It can also nourish the scalp and prevent premature graying.
Skin health: Amla oil can help brighten the skin, reduce signs of aging, and prevent skin infections.
Eye health: Amla oil contains vitamin A, which can be beneficial for the eyes.
Cardiovascular health: Amla oil contains calcium, iron, potassium, flavonoids, and anthocyanin, which can help reduce bad cholesterol and keep the heart healthy.
Immune function: Amla oil is rich in vitamin C, which can boost immunity.
Anti-inflammatory and anti-bacterial properties: Amla oil can help cure scalp infections and soothe irritated skin.
Other health benefits: Amla oil may also help with sore throats, coughs, cold and flu recovery time, and more.
Amla oil is rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals. Cold-pressed extraction preserves the oil's natural properties.
